assertions.name: cyclotomic_boundary_at_keystone_order
assertions.source: D(2..5) all cyclotomic, D(6) first non-cyclotomic — the cyclotomic-pure regime n≤5 equals {calibration c=1,2,3 → n=2,3,4} ∪ {S₅ keystone n=5}. MECHANISM: the keystone n=5 dims are the E₈ McKay marks [1]_q,[4]_q,[5]_q,[5]_q+1 (A₅ icosahedral, 2I↔Ê₈, #3685); A₅ is the last McKay-ADE alternating group and the McKay-mark structure exits at A₆ (n=6), where D(6) leaves the cyclotomic ring. n=6 is also the unique exceptional S₆ (outer automorphism). Correlation; causation open.

description: conj:cyclotomic-boundary-at-keystone (lever-1/z2bn). The Habiro-tail D(n) is cyclotomic (Habiro-pure) exactly for n≤5, and n=5 is the framework's keystone order (S₅⊃A₅ icosahedral): the cyclotomic-pure regime = {calibration orders c=1,2,3 → n=2,3,4} ∪ {S₅ keystone n=5}; first non-cyclotomic content at n=6 = first order beyond cal+keystone. MECHANISM (ties to merged #3685): at n=5 the four bwS0 conjugation classes of S₅ carry dim_q = the E₈ McKay marks [1]_q,[4]_q,[5]_q,[5]_q+1 (McKay 2I↔Ê₈, exact no-fit); A₅ = icosahedral = the LAST McKay-ADE alternating group (A₄↔Ê₆, A₅↔Ê₈, A₆ not binary polyhedral). At n=6 the McKay-mark structure exits (4/11 single-[m]_q vs 6/7+split at n=5) and D(6) leaves the cyclotomic ring. Two dovetailing candidate causes: (a) A₅ = last McKay-ADE alt. group; (b) n=6 = the UNIQUE S_n with a nontrivial outer automorphism (S₆). Mechanism = Stage-7 Φ_d|D(d+1) + McKay-mark exit at A₆; causation OPEN (formalization target). Arithmetic (not-Salem, generic core) = Stages 7-9 (2026-06-28), CITED not re-derived; McKay value map = #3685, CITED. Correlation only, magnitudes not interpreted. Scope-(a), no fit, no wiring.
